versions.scplainer: workflow in scp 1.22.0; no separate package

processing: SampleType excludes carrier, reference, blank, negative and unused channels
Pair exact cell/protein IDs to the accepted variance population; no new QC threshold
Quantified if any PSM is finite and >0; log2 positive raw intensities; per-run protein median; no normalisation
Reverse/contaminant PSM annotations excluded as non-target identities; ambiguous group IDs never invented
